title: The Whitman Sisters, Pops and Louie and Mamie Smith
summary: He recalls the Whitman Sisters and their young dancer and a visit by Mamie Smith, with a small group behind her.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And I imagine this was -- well they had the theaters there -- these different shows used to come through. I remember one show was -- came through there -- the Whitman Sisters.
Have you ever heard that?
Whitman?
Whitman. W-H-I-T-M-A-N.
Were they black or white?
They were black.
I've heard of sisters called the Whitman -- Whit-M-A-N. Whitman.
That's what Freddie said.
Yeah. Right.
Yeah, man, I know you must have heard about them. You must, as far as history is concerned.
Yeah.

They have got to be recorded somehow. But the Whitman sisters -- they came through, and they had two kids. Two kids used to dance with -- oh, what's the name of those kids? You see, remember we had a Pops and Louie. Have you ever heard of them, Pops --
Yeah.
A dance team called Pops and Louie. Now Pops -- he was the kid of the Whitman Sisters. They were -- the two sisters -- they were dancers. They were terrific tap dancers.
They were?
And they had -- they would -- little Pops -- he was the son.
And then?
And he was a kid during that period. And I used to go to this theater, and I saw them in Charleston, I was, you know. And, as I say I used to watch them dance and come back home --
Oh Get home and --
-- and try to imitate what they did.
Yeah.
And Mamie Smith --
Mamie -- Yeah, right.
-- and other blues singers, etcetera, came through there, too?
Yeah, all of the blues singers. But I remember her, you know, coming through there.
Well, what do you remember of her. Tell me more -- what how it was?
I mean, she wasn't as good as Bessie, was she?
No, no. Well, I don't know, whether really, you know. During that period, as I say, I was a kid, really, I don't know what --
Was she a big woman?
I don't know. I don't remember whether if she was big.
Yeah, you just don't remember the details --
Just vaguely, you know, I remember back that far.
And what would they do? Would they have --
They would have a group of a couple of instruments --
A couple of instruments? What instruments?
You know, like the piano, I think a drum and a trumpet -- are the ones I remember. I'm sure they must have had --
Well, what was the -- just incidentally -- do you remember the first time you heard something that hit you. You know, like if Joe Smith had been back of Bessie, or somebody -- it might
have struck you.
Mm hmm.
Do you remember anything like that? Maybe you actually never heard anything that really hit? down there Mr. Dance: I bet you did.
Not really. Well.
Well, if you were interested in dancing, he Mr. Dance: Oh. might have been busy thinking about the show rather than what he was listening to.
That's true.
Yeah. Well --
I don't know.
